First Snow and Moonlight — Scott Buckley
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/first-snow/
https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/moonlight/
Original recordings transcoded to AAC 64 kb/s for web playback.

Environmental and action sounds are generated by the application with Web Audio.
They are original procedural audio, not third-party field recordings.
Requested Pixabay assets are not bundled; see docs/audio-source-review.md.
